question: Which of the following is one of the notable works of Vikram Seth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A Suitable Boy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikram Seth** is an Indian novelist, poet, and travel writer.
 
• **"A Suitable Boy" **is a novel published in 1993, which is a story of a young girl named Lata and her journey of finding a suitable groom for herself in post-partition India.
 
• The novel is set in the 1950s and is one of the longest novels ever published in a single volume in the English language.
 
• Indian poet and novelist Vikram Seth. He is the author of multiple poetry and fiction collections. Numerous honors, including the Crossword Book Award, WH Smith Literary Award, Pravasi Bharatiya Samman, Sahitya Academy Award, and Padma Shri, have been bestowed upon him.
 
• Seth has made significant contributions to the canon of Indian English language poetry with his poetry volumes, including Mappings and Beastly Tales.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Show Business" **is not a notable work of Vikram Seth, but he has written a book on the same topic called "Beastly Tales from Here and There," which is a collection of animal fables.
 
• **"Ancient India"** is not a notable work of Vikram Seth, but he has written a book on the same topic called "Two Lives," which is a memoir of his great-uncle and aunt.
 
• **"The Glass Palace"** is a novel written by Amitav Ghosh and not Vikram Seth.
